verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows that the Plus plan includes 'classes' as a feature label in pricing (kick-supp-pricing), but there is no documentation of a report builder that lets users filter/group by class, location, or tag dimensions, nor any mention of 'location' or 'tag' dimensions at all. Missing for 10: documented custom report builder UI, filter/group-by controls, evidence of location dimension, evidence of tag dimension.
